description: Real public discussions that were actually read, one entry each: id, channel (linkedin|x), url, fetched_at (YYYY-MM-DD), fetch_method (public_page_read), a short excerpt, topic_key. Reply suggestions are generated only for entries here. Empty means no discussion has been captured: LinkedIn and X threads cannot be read reliably without a signed-in browser session, which needs the account identity and access to be verified first.
